0.0.n: This noun refers to the meal whose timing determines when the items should arrive.

0.1.n: Links 食事 to 前, making the phrase 食事の前, before the meal.

0.2.n: Follows 食事の to indicate a time earlier than the meal.

0.3.n: Marks 食事の前 as the time when you want the items brought.

0.4.n: 持つ becomes 持って; adding きて gives bring here, and ほしい expresses wanting someone else to do it.

0.5.n: Follows the whole wish to specify the situation in which the next phrase applies.

0.6.n: Marks this situation as the topic, setting up what to say.

1.0.n: Here, the beginning means before the meal rather than alongside it or afterward.

1.1.n: Marks 最初 as your chosen serving time in this request.

1.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

2.0.n: Here, the beginning means before the meal rather than alongside it or afterward.

2.1.n: Marks 最初 as your chosen serving time in this request.

2.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

3.0.n: This noun names what you want the items served alongside.

3.1.n: Pairs with 同時に to identify what should happen at the same time.

3.2.n: 同時 means simultaneous timing; に lets it describe when the items should be brought.

3.3.n: 持つ becomes 持って; adding きて gives bring here, and ほしい expresses wanting someone else to do it.

3.4.n: Follows the whole wish to specify the situation in which the next phrase applies.

3.5.n: Marks this situation as the topic, setting up what to say.

4.0.n: Here, this means the items should arrive with the meal.

4.1.n: Marks 一緒 as your chosen serving arrangement in this request.

4.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

5.0.n: Here, this means the items should arrive with the meal.

5.1.n: Marks 一緒 as your chosen serving arrangement in this request.

5.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

6.0.n: This noun refers to the meal whose timing determines when the items should arrive.

6.1.n: Links 食事 to あと, making the phrase 食事のあと, after the meal.

6.2.n: Follows 食事の to indicate a time later than the meal.

6.3.n: Marks 食事のあと as the time when you want the items brought.

6.4.n: 持つ becomes 持って; adding きて gives bring here, and ほしい expresses wanting someone else to do it.

6.5.n: Follows the whole wish to specify the situation in which the next phrase applies.

6.6.n: Marks this situation as the topic, setting up what to say.

7.0.n: A compact noun equivalent to 食事のあと, often used for serving times or medicine instructions.

7.1.n: Marks 食後 as your chosen serving time in this request.

7.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

8.0.n: A compact noun equivalent to 食事のあと, often used for serving times or medicine instructions.

8.1.n: Marks 食後 as your chosen serving time in this request.

8.2.n: A polite request formula used after stating your preferred option.

0.lit: As for when you want someone to bring them before the meal,
0.tip: A verb in its て-form followed by ほしい expresses wanting someone else to perform that action.

1.lit: With the beginning option, I request it.
1.tip: Use your chosen option plus でお願いします to politely state your preference.

2.lit: With the beginning option, I request it.
2.tip: 最初 refers to service before the meal in this context.

3.lit: As for when you want someone to bring them at the same time as the meal,
3.tip: 食事と同時に means at the same time as the meal, with と identifying the matching event.

4.lit: With the together option, I request it.
4.tip: 一緒でお願いします asks for the items to arrive with the meal, without repeating what those items are.

5.lit: With the together option, I request it.
5.tip: The meal is understood from context, so 一緒 alone is enough to specify the timing.

6.lit: As for when you want someone to bring them after the meal,
6.tip: 食事のあとに marks the requested delivery time as after the meal.

7.lit: With the after-meal option, I request it.
7.tip: 食後 is a compact way to say 食事のあと.

8.lit: With the after-meal option, I request it.
8.tip: で marks your selected timing here, not the location where something happens.
